claimText: Public health authorities have manipulated data regarding vaccine safety, particularly concerning the MMR vaccine and autism.
scope: MMR vaccine and autism data manipulation
groundingText:
[U0037] Senior CDC scientist turned whistleblower William Thompson revealed privately in 2014 that data linking the MMR vaccine (measles/mumps/rubella) to autism had been manipulated by the agency ten years earlier.
[U0041] The fraudulent, re-worked study was then released to declare that it had proven MMR vaccines did not cause autism.
[U0344] Instead the CDC “massaged” the data and in 2003 released a reworked, fraudulent version of the study loudly trumpeting that thimerosal did not cause autism and other neurodevelomental problems.
disputedProposition: Public health authorities have manipulated data regarding vaccine safety, particularly concerning the MMR vaccine and autism.
whyThisTarget: The dispute centers on whether the manipulation of data regarding the MMR vaccine and autism actually occurred.
supportCriteria: Evidence of data manipulation by public health authorities regarding the MMR vaccine and autism. | Documentation from whistleblower William Thompson confirming data manipulation.
refuteCriteria: Evidence showing that public health authorities did not manipulate data regarding the MMR vaccine and autism.
qualifyCriteria: Data manipulation occurred but did not specifically relate to the MMR vaccine and autism.

groundingText:

[U0071] This get-out-of-jail-free card, eliminating industry responsibility for safety, was unprecedented.

qualifyCriteria: The Act eliminated liability but did not lead to increased vaccine production.

claimText: There has been a significant increase in chronic health conditions among vaccinated children compared to previous generations.
scope: Chronic health conditions in vaccinated children
groundingText:

[U0090] But after embarking on the world’s most aggressive vaccination program, the U.S. had twice as many first-day infant deaths as all 27 EU nations combined .
[U0091] An analysis of two decades of U.S. data (1990-2010) showed that infants who received the most vaccines had the worst hospitalization and death rates.
